Attest verifier

Checks Attest records on this device, with no Attest service: signed agreements, receipts, certificates, Proof Cards and zero-knowledge proofs. Every signature, fingerprint and proof is checked here, and every anchor is read from a public blockchain.

Drop a signed PDF or an evidence file here, or click to choose.
Evidence files (attest-evidence-….json) download from each receipt, certificate, Proof Card and proof page. Add the original file or PDF to check it too. Nothing is uploaded.

How this works

Every fingerprint is SHA-256. Passkey signatures are WebAuthn assertions over the SHA-256 of an exact statement. Issuers sign with P-256 keys: certificates as W3C Verifiable Credentials (JOSE), Proof Cards with selective disclosure (W3C Data Integrity, ecdsa-sd-2023). Zero-knowledge proofs are Groth16 over BN254. Each record, issuer key, revocation and status change is anchored on a public blockchain, under a value this page recomputes and reads from the chain. Every format and check is specified in FORMAT.md, so any SHA-256 tool, WebAuthn library, credential library, Groth16 verifier and Ethereum node can repeat them.
